messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout v2026.06.02 failing in cluster-eu-central-1 — within 2m several canary pods entered CrashLoopBackOff. Canary traffic ~3.5%. Rolling rollback guard engaged.
Maya Chen: paging — im on-call, looking now. thanks for the alert.
Zach Rivera: joining. any customer-facing impact yet?
deploy-bot: Observability: ~3.5% of inference requests routed to canary returned 5xx (502/500) between 2026-06-02T11:12:05Z and 2026-06-02T11:16:20Z. Liveness probe failing on new pods.
Priya Nair: can someone grab pod logs? might be missing mount or env.
Maya Chen: logs from redwood-infer-canary-1cf3: ```
[2026-06-02T11:12:08Z] ERROR healthcheck GET /_internal/health -> 500
[2026-06-02T11:12:09Z] FATAL model loader: Model directory not found: /models/gpt-j-2
[2026-06-02T11:12:09Z] FATAL startup: missing model volume mount REDWOOD_MODEL_VOLUME
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/loader.py", line 72, in load_model
RuntimeError: Model directory missing
```
Zach Rivera: confirmed. Chart migration in PR-6173 renamed values.modelVolume -> values.artifactVolume and the template change removed the volumeMount for /models for the canary track. CI passed because the new value exists in the new release track, but we forgot backward-compatible fallback for the active canary cluster.
Priya Nair: that explains it. options to mitigate: (1) flip canary routing feature flag to stop traffic, (2) hotpatch deployment to set a fallback env that points to an existing path, (3) rollback the release. Which is fastest?
Maya Chen: feature-flag kill switch looks quickest with lowest blast radius. ill coordinate.
Zach Rivera: toggling flag now. POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/canary-route/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"enabled":false}'
Maya Chen: :white_check_mark: flag toggled at 2026-06-02T11:14:05Z. deploy-bot: Canary traffic dropping — now 0% routed to canary. Errors falling back to baseline within ~40s.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary traffic 0%. Autoscaler stable.
Priya Nair: while traffic is parked at stable, i'm going to hotpatch the canary deployment with a safe fallback env so pods can start for testing:
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/redwood-infer-canary REDWOOD_MODEL_DIR=/models/gpt-j-2 --namespace=prod
```
Priya Nair: patch applied at 2026-06-02T11:18:30Z. new pods spinning up.
Maya Chen: logs from redwood-infer-canary-4a7b after patch: ```
[2026-06-02T11:19:12Z] INFO healthcheck OK
[2026-06-02T11:19:13Z] INFO model loader: using REDWOOD_MODEL_DIR=/models/gpt-j-2
[2026-06-02T11:19:14Z] INFO startup complete
```
Zach Rivera: liveness green. recommendation: keep canary traffic at 0 until chart hotfix + CI regression merged. We should not re-ramp until we add a linter and a migration note.
Maya Chen: agreed. created PR-6174 (chart hotfix to restore volumeMounts and add a compatibility layer) and PR-6175 (chart CI: helm-lint rule and unit test to catch removal of required envs/volumes).
Priya Nair: i'll add a helm template assertion that fails CI if required volumeMounts or env names are missing for the legacy release track. also adding a step to validate both "modelVolume" and "artifactVolume" keys for a short transition window.
Maya Chen: customer-impact summary for incident record: ~3.5% of inference traffic experienced 5xx errors for ~4 minutes during canary ramp; no persistent data loss, no SLA breach per current metrics. Timeline: detect ~3m, feature-flag kill-switch ~1m, hotpatch & verify ~6m. Incident created INC-2026-2048.
Support Team: noted — we'll draft a short customer-facing blurb if customers ask. currently no escalations open.
incident-bot: Handoff scheduled: oncall -> day-shift Nora Patel at 2026-06-03T15:00:00Z.
Zach Rivera: action items: - hold release branch canary changes until PR-6174/6175 merge - add migration docs for helm value renames - add helm-lint and unit tests for env/volume presence - consider increasing liveness probe timeout in chart templates to reduce restart churn
Priya Nair: adding tasks to the release checklist and chart authoring guide. will follow up in PR comments.
Maya Chen: i'll own the postmortem draft and timeline. tagging :postmortem: — i'll post to #postmortems tomorrow. closing active mitigation updates: stable cluster metrics nominal, canary traffic remains 0. last_message_ts: 1873458110
